{{Quote|A Velmorian energy sword. You couldn't find a lightsaber, but you could find this?"<br>"Things are tough all over. I was able to obtain in an online auction from a member of the Velmorian royal family who had fallen upon hard times.|[[Laranth Tarak]] and [[Haninum Tyk Rhinann]]|<ref name="CNII:SOS" />}}
A '''Velmorian energy sword''' originally belonged to a [[Unidentified Velmorian royal family member|member]] of the [[Velmorian royal family]]. When the family member fell upon hard times they sold the [[Velmorian energy sword|sword]] on an online auction. The [[Elomin/Legends|Elomin]] [[Haninum Tyk Rhinann]] won the sword in the auction. He later handed the sword to the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jax Pavan]] to use instead of his [[Jax Pavan's vibrosword|vibrosword]], for his use until Rhinann could get the necessary equipment and materials for and find lightsaber components as the Jedi was seeking to construct a new [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. Jax kept the Velmorian flamesword in a sheath. He later used it to duel the [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] [[Sele (Cathar)|Sele]] in [[Spa Fon|Spa Fon's]] residence. Jax used the sword to repeatedly cut and sear Sele until the Cathar [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] yielded. Jax was later anonymously gifted [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing's]] [[Color/Legends|crimson]] [[Aurra Sing's lightsaber|lightsaber]] from [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gregar Typho/Legends|Gregar Typho]], to which Jax then opted to stop using the sword, having been seeking a new lightsaber for a while by then<ref name="CNII:SOS" /> after losing his [[Jax Pavan's lightsaber|original one]] in the [[Factory District]].<ref name="CNI:JT">''[[Coruscant Nights I: Jedi Twilight]]''</ref> Following the [[Ambush near the Twins|ambush]] near the [[Twins (star system)/Legends|Twins]], Jax Pavan escaped the crashing [[Far Ranger]] with only his [[Jax Pavan's third lightsaber|third lightsaber]], [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing's]] old [[Aurra Sing's lightsaber|lightsaber]], his [[Miisai|miisai tree]] and the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Sith holocron/Legends|holocron]] [[SD41263.I]].<ref name="Last Jedi">[[The Last Jedi (novel)|''The Last Jedi'']]</ref>

==Description==
The hilt of the energy sword looked to have been made from [[Electrum/Legends|electrum]]. Mounted on the guard were two smal faceted crystals. The blade was made from a pale [[Color/Legends|silver]], almost white [[Metal/Legends|metal]] and was slightly longer than a meter. The blade was reflective, though reflections would be distorted such as when Jax saw his distorted face looking back up at him from the blade. Den Dhur noted that while the weapon was not chased it seemed to have delicate whorls and patterns that seemed to move. When powered it would emit a crackling silver [[Plasma/Legends|plasmatic]] [[Fire/Legends|flame]].<ref name="CNII:SOS" /> 

The silver flame that engulfed the blade was triggered by a pressure pad in the hilt. The generator in the hilt fed the silver plasma through the crystals and along the blade while a magnetic feedback loop kept it contained on the blade. Notably, the containment loop stops the plasma from touching the metal blade, otherwise the metal would melt, which meant the blade emanated no heat after the plasma was deactivated. The plasmatic flame was strong enough to stop stun blasts from a [[Marksman-H combat remote|training remote]].<ref name="CNII:SOS" />
